def transform(grid):
    """Stamp every occurrence of the 8-pixel template onto matching zero cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    dh = max(r for r, c in shape)
    dw = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-dh):
        for c in range(w-dw):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = 8
    return out
PY
